real_test_cases.name: Card shows mold name and shot counter
real_test_cases.details: Verified on MO GMP/MOPL/00012 / WO 364. Card showed mold section, mold name, shot counter, and Mold button.

real_test_cases.name: Change mold from card before start
real_test_cases.details: Verified on WO 364. Clicking Mold opened selection dialog. Choosing TEST ALT MOLD SHOPFLOOR JOI PK W02 closed dialog, updated card, and backend mold_ids became 650.

real_test_cases.name: Full mold warning with Continue Anyway
real_test_cases.details: Verified on MO GMP/MOPL/00011 / WO 363 with mold 590 at 1000/1000 shots. Warning popup appeared and Continue Anyway started work successfully.

real_test_cases.name: Full mold warning with Change Mold then Start
real_test_cases.details: Verified on WO 364. Warning popup displayed, Change Mold opened selection dialog, choosing alternative mold updated card, and Start proceeded without repeated warning.

real_test_cases.name: Reset mold life after maintenance
real_test_cases.details: Verified on mold 590. Reset Life confirmation changed shots from 1000/1000 to 0/1000. Test value was restored afterward.

real_test_cases.name: Breakdown recovery path
real_test_cases.details: Stop/Resume operational path was verified from GMP Shop Floor. Dedicated breakdown button is not present on the card; maintenance handling remains a separate flow.

real_test_cases.name: Done/Cancel workorders do not reappear as active queue items
real_test_cases.details: Not signed off end-to-end in UAT this round because there was no suitable live sample with parallel sibling WO in Done/Cancel state on the same active queue to verify entirely through UI.

notes: Breakdown case was added to the workbook as a UAT scenario and recovery path. It is a business-operation test path, not a newly added dedicated button in GMP Shop Floor.
Reset mold life uses the existing mold smart button on the Work Center form.
